svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
svg.title: civil-buddy — one-company zero-trust agent platform
svg.desc: Architecture of civil-buddy framed as a one-company zero-trust agent platform: a control plane, an entry gateway, an agent runtime, a model gateway and a tool gateway, with touch-points, a model pool, the company's data and engines, an improvement loop and the six rules. Every box carries a status badge: LIVE, OPT-IN, BEFORE DEMO, ROADMAP or NOT NEEDED.
svg.text: Control plane + 3 gateways, sized for an SME on one AWS server
Target: one AWS Lightsail instance per company, staff in a browser. Not yet running at d3ada11 (2026-09-26).
